title: Support Escalation Guide
body: Support tickets that turn out to be product incidents (not user error or a how-to question) escalate from the support queue to Engineering by tagging the ticket 'engineering-escalation' and posting a summary in #eng-oncall with a link to the ticket. Engineering's on-call rotation picks these up the same way as a direct page. Tickets suspected to involve a security or data-privacy issue escalate directly to the security team instead, bypassing the normal Engineering on-call path.
